checked_profile.summary: Home insurance quotes built around property details, coverage and agent assistance.
checked_profile.scope: Selected product features and conditions from the provider sources below. This is not a personalized offer, approval decision, or complete fee or policy schedule.

facts.label: Property details
facts.text: The quote process asks about the address, occupancy, age, size, structures, prior insurance, claims and safety features.

facts.label: Coverage and price
facts.text: State Farm uses further property and personal information to determine available coverage options, deductibles and policy cost. The national product page is not a confirmation of new-business availability for every address.

facts.label: Bundling
facts.text: State Farm offers a home and auto bundling quote through an agent. Compare the actual combined premium; advertised savings are not universal.

questions: Is this policy available for my address, vehicle or property?

What limits, deductibles, exclusions and optional coverages appear in my written quote?
